title: Noor and the Alibi
author: Freya Lockridge
blurb: Edmund Yarrow, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the tide gives up what it took.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
